text: Al-Zabadani District (Arabic: منطقة الزبداني, romanized: manṭiqat al-Zabadani) is a district within the Rif Dimashq Governorate in southern Syria, with its administrative centre in the city of al-Zabadani. As recorded in the 2004 census, the district had a population of 63,780.[1] Prior to February 2009, the sub-districts of Ayn al-Fijah and al-Dimas were part of Al-Zabadani District; they were later incorporated to form the newly established Qudsaya District.[2] The town-resort of Bloudan, located within the al-Zabadani district, is a popular tourist destination for both locals and foreigners. The district is divided into three sub-districts or nawāḥī, with population data from 2004.[1] According to the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS), the district comprises various villages, towns, and cities.[1] This article about a location in Rif Dimashq Governorate, Syria is a stub.
